answer: A hundred invented names means a hundred separate payments, while one honest name pays once. The fable is that the door answers to Elected brewer fellowship patent alone, and a patent brewers hold after mash reviews is the lock it turns. Before the stamp comes a waiting period of 7 days that no payment can shorten, and a name that cannot pay it never gets stamped. marble is written on the receipt. The pearl is on the docket.
